explanations.wrong_signs: none: every applied or suggested sign equals the gait2392 sign under rule B

skipped.why: fewer than 5 parsed strides per leg ({'left': 0, 'right': 0})

hip_angle_suggest.why: Ambiguous on all three 10-degree inclines (markers and stance extension count as one family). Stair descent is outside hip stance extension; AB01 decline 10 cast 2 stance-extension votes; AB13 stair ascent had 4 marker votes (< 5).

knee_angle.why: The knee-range test is walking-only (stairs excluded) and cast fewer than 5 votes on the 10-degree slopes; markers alone give suggest. AB13 stair ascent: the marker test had 4 votes (< 5), so abstain.

ankle_angle_suggest.why: Stair descent is outside the push-off test; AB13 stair ascent had 4 marker votes.

hip_moment.why: Applied on level and incline legs (ID-light + stance timing). On declines ID-light cast no votes (|r| < 0.6; cause not checked) or the CoP-within-foot check failed, so stance timing alone gives suggest. Stairs are outside stance timing and ID-light had fewer than 5 votes: abstain.

knee_moment.why: One family only (lever arm): suggest by design. Abstain where the lever arm abstained (CoP-within-foot failure on AB01 decline 10; 4 votes on AB13 stair ascent).

ankle_moment_suggest.why: AB01 decline 10: CoP-within-foot failed, so the lever arm abstained; late stance alone gives suggest.

powers.why: Apply needs the power identity (moment and angle applied) plus power timing. Hip power timing is level-walking only (scope change after UM21) and ankle power timing excludes declines and stair descent, so those legs rest on the identity (suggest) or abstain. Knee power has the identity only.

hip_lever_arm_half.why: Weak test (score 0); flagged "other leg?" although the column is this leg's, as in UM21; no effect.

pelvis_heading.why: GT23 publishes no pelvis angle, so no pelvis sign is tested. Headings (pelvis ASIS-PSIS vs the heel-to-toe axis) are within 28 deg in every trial and pass; left legs negative and right legs positive, consistent with foot toe-out. No reversed pelvis (contrast: UMich AB04/i0 at 180 deg).
pelvis_heading.note: The forward axis is the heel-to-toe axis of the analysed foot, so it carries foot toe-out (about 5-28 deg). Projection scales sagittal angles by cos(toe-out) but cannot change a sign; a pelvis- or two-foot-based axis would be better for magnitudes.

moment_scale.why: GT23 published moments and powers are divided by another participant's mass for the subjects listed (GT23-C03 divisors below). Every detector decision here is scale-free (correlation and slope signs, contrasts relative to each unit's peak); lever-arm and ID-light slopes are not interpreted.

resources.mode: read-only probe exception; one trial at a time; nice 19, ionice idle, 1 thread; RLIMIT_AS 1.5 GiB

forward_axis: per-stride pelvis facing (horizontal ASIS-mid minus PSIS-mid), foot axis as fallback
question: Does the detector (rule B, cross-family tests) reproduce the gait2392 signs of GaTech 2023 across level, incline, decline and stair walking, and abstain rather than err?
selection: numpy default_rng(seed).permutation over the 12 README subjects; first 3 with segmentation for every condition; all seven conditions each.

ground_truth.source: sign-conventions-source-survey.json (GT23: gait2392, knee flexion negative; author plot code and paper) and GT23-C02 (ankle sign, power = moment x velocity), mapped to rule B
ground_truth.pelvis: not published in GT23 (no pelvis channel)

adapter.channels: Joint_Angle hip_flexion/knee_angle/ankle_angle (deg -> rad); Joint_Moments *_moment (published N*m/kg, divisor per GT23-C03); Joint_Powers (W/kg)
adapter.units: Segmentation/<subject>/<task>_parsing.mat stride start/end times (dataset segmentation), resampled to 150 samples; durations from the times
adapter.markers: .trc (mm -> m): CAL heel, mean MT1/MT5 toe, mean ANK/MANK ankle, mean KNE/MKNE knee, GTR hip proxy, ASIS/PSIS midpoints; each stride projected on its pelvis facing (horizontal ASIS-mid minus PSIS-mid), foot heel-to-toe axis as fallback, Y up
adapter.plates: GroundFrame_GRFs (N, m; OpenSim ground frame) for the analysed side; GRF unit N with the participant README mass
adapter.cop_registration: none: plate CoP (GroundFrame_GRFs) and markers (.trc) are both in the OpenSim ground frame; no shift applied; tested by the detector CoP-within-foot check

hip_moment.why: Applied where ID-light and stance timing agree. v1 cause of the low decline ID-light correlations (verifier, pilot_gt23): the forward axis was one foot's heel-to-toe line, which toe-out rotates 5-21 deg from the person's facing, so frontal forces leaked into the sagittal estimate (verifier with the pelvis axis: AB01 decline 5 0.39 -> 0.95; AB13 decline 10 0.25 -> 0.54; AB06 decline 5 0.74 -> 0.85). v2 uses the per-stride pelvis facing and reproduces this. Remaining suggests: AB01 decline 10 (CoP-within-foot failed, so ID-light abstains), AB13 decline 10 (ID-light 4 votes), stair descent (ID-light only; stance timing excludes stairs). Stair ascent: fewer than 5 ID-light votes, abstain.

knee_moment.why: One family only (lever arm): suggest by design. Abstain where the lever arm abstained (CoP-within-foot failure on AB01 decline 10; 4 votes on AB13 stair ascent).

ankle_moment_suggest.why: AB01 decline 10: CoP-within-foot failed, so the lever arm abstained; late stance alone gives suggest.

hip_lever_arm_half.why: Weak test (score 0); flagged "other leg?" although the column is this leg's, as in UM21; no effect.

forward_axis.why: GT23 stores no pelvis angle, so no pelvis sign is tested. The marker pelvis facing differs from the analysed foot's heel-to-toe axis by 5-28 deg (toe-out: left legs negative, right legs positive); no pelvis faces backwards (contrast: UMich AB04/i0 at 180 deg). The offset was not harmless: in v1 it leaked frontal forces into the decline hip ID-light estimate. v2 projects each stride on its pelvis facing.

Every detector decision here is scale-free (correlation and slope signs, contrasts relative to each unit's peak); lever-arm and ID-light slopes are not interpreted.

Moment and power magnitudes carry the GT23-C03 normalizing-mass error; only signs are tested.

No threshold was changed for this pilot.
